policy: Every new or materially changed feature, job, dataset-facing workflow or UI surface must prove distinct utility, canonical ownership, reuse, correlation and minimal necessary presentation before G3 exit and again at G10.

items.name: Dashboard
items.purpose: Prioritize market state, Decision Queue, material risk and best current horizon opportunities.
items.reusePolicy: Reuse canonical regime, queue, event, desk and context intelligence; do not fetch independently for presentation.
items.separationReason: Primary cross-horizon decision summary; deep evidence remains in specialist surfaces.

items.name: Market Intelligence
items.purpose: Deep home for tradeability, breadth, structure, leadership, liquidity, events and contextual market evidence.
items.reusePolicy: Derive from canonical market/global/macro/options/event stores; no duplicate market-data acquisition for UI sections.
items.separationReason: Distinct market-wide deep-evidence workflow; ticker-deep evidence belongs in Research.

items.name: Day Trade Desk
items.purpose: Day-horizon Action/Score/plan/readiness with only material contextual support.
items.reusePolicy: Reuse canonical quote/history/readiness/event/global/options evidence; deep earnings/SEC/news detail links to Research.
items.separationReason: Distinct deterministic horizon and workflow; repeated deep evidence should be compacted rather than copied.

items.name: Swing Desk
items.purpose: Swing-horizon Action/Score/plan/readiness with material contextual support.
items.reusePolicy: Reuse canonical history/readiness/event/global/options evidence; deep evidence links to Research.

items.name: Long-Term Desk
items.purpose: Long-horizon Action/Score/plan/readiness with material fundamental and persistent contextual support.
items.reusePolicy: Reuse canonical history/fundamentals/SEC/readiness/global evidence; full filing/evidence detail remains in Research.

items.name: Discovery Scanner
items.purpose: User/cadence-driven Day/Swing/Long candidate generation and ranking.
items.reusePolicy: Use shared canonical/short-lived broad snapshot acquisition and existing market-activity/history evidence where fresh.
items.separationReason: Ranking workflow is distinct from always-on Radar detection even though acquisition should be shared.

items.name: Opportunity Radar
items.purpose: Always-on bounded detection and promotion of unusual volume, volatility, dislocation and material context.
items.reusePolicy: Share/coalesce broad snapshots with Scanner when fresh; reuse market activity, canonical news/filings/community and live-priority evidence.
items.separationReason: Always-on promotion lifecycle differs from user/cadence ranking; shared acquisition prevents duplicate provider work.

items.name: Rapid Move / Market Shock
items.owner: Canonical live quote pipeline / Rapid Move intelligence
items.purpose: Low-latency event-driven detection, validation and explanation of material short-window dislocations.
items.reusePolicy: Evaluate directly from canonical quote changes and existing event/provider evidence; no separate polling loop.
items.separationReason: Event-driven latency requirement is distinct from Scanner/Radar cadence while sharing canonical evidence.

items.name: Research
items.purpose: Canonical deep home for one-symbol earnings, fundamentals, SEC/ownership, catalysts and technical context.
items.reusePolicy: Hydrate/reconcile canonical evidence only when needed; other surfaces reuse compact conclusions and link here for depth.

items.name: AI Copilot
items.purpose: Full interactive Research Confirmation, Risk Review, Catalyst Review and custom evidence-grounded questions.
items.reusePolicy: Consume frozen canonical evidence packages and cached unchanged-evidence results; never create independent market-data acquisition.
items.separationReason: Research shows a compact second-opinion result; AI Copilot owns the full interactive review workflow.

items.name: Pre-Market Prep
items.purpose: Pre-session freshness/prewarm checkpoint over canonical evidence required for market readiness.
items.reusePolicy: Request due evidence through canonical refresh/router/cache; never own an independent analysis/fetch pipeline.
items.separationReason: Distinct temporal checkpoint; user-facing value is readiness/change summary, not a separate tab.

items.name: Market Open Prep
items.purpose: 9:20–9:25 ET reconciliation of current overnight/premarket evidence and material setup/readiness changes before the bell.
items.reusePolicy: Reconcile canonical current state and refresh only due material evidence through shared scheduler/router.
items.separationReason: Distinct synchronized pre-bell checkpoint; not a separate scanner or tab.

items.name: Earnings & Material Catalyst Reaction Watch
items.purpose: Selective event lifecycle tracking from scheduled/material catalyst through reaction and outcome windows.
items.reusePolicy: Reuse canonical earnings/news/SEC/quote/liquidity evidence; activate selectively rather than broad always-on polling.
items.separationReason: Event-reaction lifecycle is distinct from candidate discovery but belongs under canonical Event Intelligence.

items.name: Market Activity Seeds
items.purpose: Low-cost most-active/gainer/loser seeds for Scanner/Radar discovery.
items.reusePolicy: Fetch once according to provider cadence and reuse as discovery seeds.
items.separationReason: Useful ingredient but not a distinct decision product for normal users.

items.name: Legacy standalone News/Earnings/Filings routes
items.purpose: Legacy direct pages retained by older renderer routes.
items.reusePolicy: Route detailed ticker evidence to Research and market-wide events to Market Intelligence instead of maintaining duplicate homes.
items.separationReason: No longer justified as independent evidence homes.

items.name: Administration
items.purpose: Capability-scoped user, role, session and presence administration separated from market/research settings.
items.reusePolicy: Reuse canonical identity/session stores and capability authorization; no role-specific duplicate market pipelines.
items.newTabJustification: Distinct security/capability workflow whose actions and hierarchy do not belong in market Settings or Maintenance; navigation is capability-scoped.
items.separationReason: Clear security and workflow boundary for delegated administration.

items.name: Maintenance
items.purpose: Operational truth for provider health, cache/storage, jobs, runtime load, capabilities, validation and QA evidence.
items.reusePolicy: Observe canonical runtime/governance state; do not create alternate market intelligence solely for diagnostics.
items.separationReason: Distinct operational workflow; user-facing conclusions belong in primary intelligence surfaces.

items.name: Settings
items.purpose: Configure what DE.PULSE should do, providers/AI modes and authorized personal/application preferences.
items.reusePolicy: Configuration only; runtime operational truth remains in Maintenance.
items.separationReason: Configuration is intentionally separate from operational diagnosis.

items.name: Documentation
items.purpose: Role-aware user, capability, developer and governance documentation.
consumers: Users and authorized operators according to role/capability
items.reusePolicy: Reference canonical product/governance truth; avoid duplicating live operational state as documentation.
items.separationReason: Documentation is a distinct support workflow.
